observations: Baro et al., Br J Cancer 2014;111:1310–1318; DOI:10.1038/bjc.2014.432. In FaDu and A431 xenografts irradiated 30 Gy in 10 fractions, adding dasatinib to cetuximab plus radiotherapy increased tumour growth, DNA synthesis, and angiogenesis and worsened tumour control.

entities.name: Dasatinib worsens cetuximab-RT
observations: In FaDu- and A431-derived xenografts, dasatinib added to cetuximab plus fractionated radiotherapy worsened tumour control; tumour growth, DNA synthesis, and angiogenesis increased. Radiation was 30 Gy in 10 fractions.
